options.content: Joint target-book execution path split by local and global role. Target-book charts come from `JointTargetBook`; rejection charts count rejected candidates/orders by reason; gate-block charts count blocked frames by reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       venue AS metric,
       SUM(jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(book->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES ('local', payload->'local')
) AS v(venue, book)
WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND book IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH target_books AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'target orders'::text AS metric,
         SUM(jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
venue_gates AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         stage.metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN stage.ok THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gate(key, value)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      ('gate has orders', COALESCE(NULLIF(gate.value->>'has_orders', ''), 'false')::boolean),
      ('gate can sync', COALESCE(NULLIF(gate.value->>'can_sync', ''), 'false')::boolean),
      ('gate live', COALESCE(NULLIF(gate.value->>'live', ''), 'false')::boolean)
  ) AS stage(metric, ok)
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
    AND COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') = 'local'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT "time", metric, value FROM target_books
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", metric, value FROM venue_gates
ORDER BY 1

WITH role_rejections AS (
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       ('risk: ' || reason.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','rejection_counts'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND NOT (reason.key LIKE 'global_%'
       OR reason.key IN ('missing_global_market_data', 'stale_global_market_data', 'missing_global_ledger'))

UNION ALL
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       (stage_label || ': ' || reason.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('venue_quantized', 'venue limits'),
    ('capped', 'order shaping'),
    ('rules_valid', 'exchange rules'),
    ('router_accepted', 'router')
) AS stages(stage, stage_label)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stage, 'rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
)
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM role_rejections
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH role_rejections AS (
SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       ('risk: ' || reason.key) AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','rejection_counts'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'

  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])

  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND (reason.key LIKE 'global_%'
       OR reason.key IN ('missing_global_market_data', 'stale_global_market_data', 'missing_global_ledger'))

)
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM role_rejections
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       blocked.reason AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
) AS blocked(reason)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') = 'local'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
       blocked.reason AS metric,
       COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
) AS blocked(reason)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') = 'global'

SELECT e.ts,
       e.actor_id,
       e.exchange,
       e.symbol,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS desired_orders,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS risk_approved_orders,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS router_accepted_orders,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS new_order_commands,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_cancel','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_cancel','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS cancel_commands,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS unchanged_existing_orders,
       COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb) AS risk_blocks,
       COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb) AS rule_blocks,
       COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb) AS router_blocks
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 50
